title: Fixed Table Screw and Open Beak Sewing Bird
description: One newly authored complete sewing-bird-inspired craft clamp in a fixed open pose. A single continuous C-shaped table-edge frame includes its upper bird mount and a finite flat lower resting surface. A complete vertical shaft with integral pressure pad, one capped four-turn helical ridge and one flared transverse handle occupy the lower jaw; a real empty table gap remains beneath the upper arm. The complete stationary lower bird body and raised upper bird head/tail meet a whole transverse axle, with an actual open gap between their blunt beak tips. One entire curved flat tail spring joins the rear portions, and two plain small eye studs make the simple unornamented bird outline readable. Every full profile, curve, jaw outline, support and screw coordinate is newly authored. Unlike the clamp-on bench vise there is no sliding front flat jaw, rectangular slide guide or second long screw translating the work jaws; unlike the clothespin basket there is no basket or three repeated opposed wooden clips with central coil springs. This complete mount-and-pivoted-bird organization is not old clamp geometry with a bird ornament added or an extracted clothes clip. Ten closed editable whole meshes, four opaque untextured metal-look PBR roles, metres native Z up and whole horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One model zero scenes, no extra component count. Plain broad category inspiration only, not a museum-object replica, patented mechanism, historical proportion, branded sewing aid or copied feather ornament. The apparent hinge, helical ridge and flat spring are fixed visual geometry with explicit finite attachment overlaps, not a working fit, spring law or tested movement. No tabletop or cloth is supplied; the lower C-frame resting surface is only a neutral static display datum, not a claim of freestanding balance or actual clamping. No gripping force, thread pitch compatibility, opening travel, needlework performance, pinch protection, load, manufacture, handling or safety capability supplied. No rig, animation or interaction.
